text: Keep the Sense holder adjustable along the carbon-fibre rod, with the distal end as its default position.
Both an open-pattern and an opaque sliding cover were considered. The discussion did not settle visibility as a requirement.
Locate the XIAO Sense board at its sides and retain it over the top or with a keeper. Leave clearance beside and underneath for hand-soldered joints and attached wires.
Both rod attachment rings and the top of the XIAO cradle must survive printing, removal of the base and normal handling.
Keep the tip sensor close to the rod and point its USB port up toward the computer, away from the keys.
A narrower USB opening was considered for the older holder. The existing height fitted well and narrowing the opening was left undecided.
